summary.text: Megan Wingfield, a Democratic mechanic from Bowling Green, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Kentucky's 2nd Congressional District to Brett Guthrie.
Her campaign website describes her as a caregiver and activist.

paragraphs.text: According to her campaign website, Wingfield was born and raised in Bowling Green, Kentucky. She graduated from Southcentral Kentucky Community and Technical College with a degree in Automotive Technology and built her career as a mechanic.
Her campaign website said she was running on working families, affordable healthcare and a fair shot for every Kentucky family.
She received 35.1% of the vote to Brett Guthrie's 62.8%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
